meta.description: Single source of truth for all Noble Architecture standard SketchUp tags (layers). Drives the TrueVision3D GlbBuilder export segmentation, storey detection, Layout linework thickness mapping, and tag creation. All field names use domain prefixes: Tag__ (core identity), Glb__ (GLB exporter), Storey__ (storey system), Layout__ (SketchUp Layout), SitePlan__ (site plan drawing export).
meta.namingConvention: Tags use the format: {NN}__{Category}__{Subcategory}. The numeric prefix controls sort order and export range grouping. Double underscores separate all name parts.

fieldPrefixes.Glb__: GLB exporter behaviour (export ranges, exclusion, filename stem)
fieldPrefixes.Storey__: Storey-based export system (container flag, element name)
fieldPrefixes.Glb__Linework: Linetype linework export (TrueVision model GLBs): an entry carrying Glb__LineworkOnly is a LINETYPE tag - geometry on it is never written to a mesh GLB or to a category linework GLB, and its edges are collected at any nesting depth into a GLB of their own, {prefix}{Glb__ExportFileNameStem}__LineworkModel__.glb. Glb__LineworkLineType is the TrueVision EdgeStyles alias the drawing editors are expected to draw it with; the app-side mapping lives in Na__LayoutEditor__ModelLayers__Config__.json.
fieldPrefixes.Layout__: SketchUp Layout + SketchUp model edge presentation (edge colour mapping, line style, usage notes). Layout__LineStyleName drives Sketchup::Layer#line_style= via Sketchup.active_model.line_styles[name]; valid names are listed in the LineStyleReference block at the bottom of this file.
fieldPrefixes.SitePlan__: Site plan drawing export (TrueVision site plan layers): export stem, layer label and group, draw order, whether closed faces export as fills, default line colour (EdgeMaterials MTE id), line type (TrueVision EdgeStyles alias), line weight in paper mm, fill colour and opacity, and the scale denominators the layer shows at by default. An entry carrying SitePlan__ExportFileNameStem is a site plan layer; such entries carry no Glb__ExportFileNameStem.
fieldPrefixes.LineworkModifier__: Nested detail-weight tags (the 76-79 range): a tag applied to geometry nested INSIDE an already-tagged parent of ANY numbered category (never used at the model's top level, and never as a bare Storey-container child), so it rides in the parent's GLB under its own glTF node name instead of exporting to a bucket of its own. LineworkModifier__StyleKey is the TrueVision__LineworkModifier__* owner key the drawing editors resolve to a weight/colour; LineworkModifier__WeightFactor and LineworkModifier__EdgeColourId record the same style here for traceability; LineworkModifier__AppliesToHostCategories is prose, not a restriction - the '__Walls'/'__WindowsAndJoinery' half of each tag name is the detail's STYLE FAMILY (masonry/structural vs joinery/glazing), and neither the exporter nor TrueVision3D's Stage Sampler ever inspect what the parent is actually tagged.

meta.skipRangesNote: Tags with these numeric IDs are ignored by the GLB exporter and not exported.

00__ModelFlagTags__.Tag__Description: Model-flag tags that control GLB export behaviour for specific geometry categories. Linework-hidden tags keep mesh geometry but suppress edges in the linework GLB at any nesting depth. Fully-excluded tags are stripped from both mesh and linework GLBs.

01__ModelFlag__FloorLevel__IndicatorLine.Tag__Description: Floor level reference lines drawn as construction aids. Mesh geometry on this tag is exported normally; edges are suppressed in the linework GLB at any nesting depth so they do not appear as visible lines in TrueVision3D.

01__ModelFlag__BuildingJoins__IndicatorL.Tag__Description: Building join / party wall reference lines used to mark interfaces between existing and proposed elements. Mesh geometry is exported normally; edges are suppressed in the category linework GLB at any nesting depth and exported instead as TrueVision__Linetype__BuildingJoins__LineworkModel__.glb, drawn as a centre line in the drawing editors.

01__ModelFlag__ElementsForRemoval.Tag__Description: Geometry earmarked for demolition or removal in the proposed scheme. No mesh is written to any GLB; its edges are exported as TrueVision__Linetype__ElementsForRemoval__LineworkModel__.glb and drawn dashed in the drawing editors.

01__ModelFlag__OverheadObjects__Indicato.Tag__Description: Overhead objects shown in plan as dashed linework (e.g. roof overhangs, high-level shelving, overhead beams). Mesh geometry is exported normally; edges are suppressed in the category linework GLB at any nesting depth and exported instead as TrueVision__Linetype__OverheadObjects__LineworkModel__.glb, drawn as a phantom line in the drawing editors.

01__OrbitHelperCube.Tag__Description: Camera orbit pivot point for the Web 3D Viewer App. A small cube component placed at the desired camera rotation centre.

02__Linetype__DoorSwings.Tag__Description: 2D door swing arc linework. Never written to a mesh or category linework GLB; exported on its own as TrueVision__Linetype__DoorSwings__LineworkModel__.glb for the drawing editors.

02__Linetype__DashedLines.Tag__Description: General-purpose 2D dashed linework. Never written to a mesh or category linework GLB; exported on its own as TrueVision__Linetype__DashedLines__LineworkModel__.glb and drawn dashed in the drawing editors.

02__Linetype__CentreLines.Tag__Description: 2D centre linework. Never written to a mesh or category linework GLB; exported on its own as TrueVision__Linetype__CentreLines__LineworkModel__.glb and drawn as a centre line in the drawing editors.

02__Linetype__DottedLines.Tag__Description: 2D dotted linework. Never written to a mesh or category linework GLB; exported on its own as TrueVision__Linetype__DottedLines__LineworkModel__.glb and drawn dotted in the drawing editors.

02__ClearanceLines__IndicatorLines.Tag__Description: Clearance zone linework (e.g. furniture clearances, accessibility zones). Never written to a mesh or category linework GLB; exported on its own as TrueVision__Linetype__ClearanceLines__LineworkModel__.glb and drawn as a fine dash in the drawing editors.

02__ProfilePathTracer_Helpers.Tag__Description: Helpers for the Profile Path Tracer tool. These are used to help the user to create a profile path for the Profile Path Tracer tool. Always excluded from GLB export.

02__DoorHelpers__RotationPivots.Tag__Description: Visible debug helpers showing the door rotation pivot consumed by TrueVision3D (ROT group inside each ADR door assembly). Drawn as red dashed lines (vertical hinge axis line + crosshairs at both ends + swing direction arc). Toggle this tag off in production - the helper geometry sits inside the ROT group whose origin is the pivot point read by the downstream Three.js animation system. Always excluded from GLB export.

02__Reference__CadLines__NotUsed.Tag__Description: Cad lines that are not used in the model. Always excluded from GLB export.

05__3dModelingUtil__MirrorPlanes.Tag__Description: Temporary mirror plane faces used as construction aids for symmetrical modeling. Always excluded from GLB export.

05__3dModelingUtil__BoundingBoxes.Tag__Description: Temporary bounding box helpers to visualize object extents or aid boolean operations. Always excluded from GLB export.
Temporary asset dimensions used for thumbnail images for Components, Always excluded from GLB export.

06__Reference__CadData__General.Tag__Description: Imported 2D or 3D CAD reference data. Leave this tag off for final exports. Always excluded from GLB export.

06__Reference__Drawings__General.Tag__Description: Reference geometry and drawing data (images, PDFs, etc.) imported for modeling guidance only. Always excluded from GLB export.

00__OriginPoint.Tag__Description: Failsafe local-origin and rotation-pivot marker group inside camera-follow billboard components. Geometry on this tag is never exported; the group centre position is captured by the GlbBuilder and baked into glTF node extras as pivotLocal for downstream ValeVision and TrueVision camera-follow behaviour.

Na__Door__Open.Tag__Description: Internal component sub-tag marking door panel geometry in its open-state position. Used by TrueVision3D animation system. Always excluded from GLB export.

Na__Door__Closed.Tag__Description: Internal component sub-tag marking door panel geometry in its closed-state position. Used by TrueVision3D animation system. Always excluded from GLB export.

Na__DoorPanel.Tag__Description: Internal component sub-tag for the door panel leaf geometry within an ADR door assembly. Always excluded from GLB export.

Na__DoorHandle.Tag__Description: Internal component sub-tag for door handle and hardware geometry within an ADR door assembly. Always excluded from GLB export.

Na__Architrave.Tag__Description: Internal component sub-tag for door architrave (trim) geometry within an ADR door assembly. Always excluded from GLB export.

03__LayoutDrawingLineworkTags__.Tag__Description: Tags for 2D Drafting Linework in Layout (SketchUps 2D Drafting Tool). The EdgePaint Plugin uses edge colours to auto-apply the corresponding linework style tag so Layout has full control of line thickness for depth cueing.

03__LineThickness__01.00pt.Tag__Description: Layout renders 1 point linework thickness on final PDF Document exported from Layout.
03__LineThickness__01.00pt.Layout__UsageNote: Rarely used, but renders the default linework thickness for the model.

03__LineThickness__00.80pt.Tag__Description: Layout renders 0.80 point linework thickness on final PDF Document exported from Layout.
03__LineThickness__00.80pt.Layout__UsageNote: Used for items you want to be visible but not too thick, such as columns on an elevation drawing.

03__LineThickness__00.50pt.Tag__Description: Layout renders 0.5 point linework thickness on final PDF Document exported from Layout.
03__LineThickness__00.50pt.Layout__UsageNote: Used for items that should be clearly visible but not too thick, such as window frames on an elevation drawing.

03__LineThickness__00.40pt.Tag__Description: Layout renders 0.40 point linework thickness on final PDF Document exported from Layout.
03__LineThickness__00.40pt.Layout__UsageNote: Used for items such as items in plan view such as furniture etc.

03__LineThickness__00.35pt.Tag__Description: Layout renders 0.35 point linework thickness on final PDF Document exported from Layout.
03__LineThickness__00.35pt.Layout__UsageNote: Used for items that should be backed off a bit more, such as subtle building motifs or door handles on elevation drawings.

03__LineThickness__00.30pt.Tag__Description: Layout renders 0.35 point linework thickness on final PDF Document exported from Layout.
03__LineThickness__00.30pt.Layout__UsageNote: Used for items backed off significantly, such as background foliage on elevation drawings.

03__LineThickness__00.25pt.Tag__Description: Layout renders 0.25 point linework thickness on final PDF Document exported from Layout.
03__LineThickness__00.25pt.Layout__UsageNote: Barely used, renders almost invisible linework.

07__Landscape.Tag__Description: Landscape and site context elements including ground surface, planting, and paving.

09__Site__Vegetation__2D.Tag__Description: 2D planar site vegetation components that always face the camera (billboard / camera-follow). Lightweight background trees, shrubs, and similar linework or face assets authored as flat SketchUp components. Exported as a dedicated GLB segment for separate visibility control in ValeVision and TrueVision.

08__Site__Boundaries.Tag__Description: Site boundary lines exported as GLB, allows for toggling of the boundaries on and off.

10__ExistingBuilding.Tag__Description: Existing building - whole massing flag. Used for simplified massing models where the entire existing building is a single object.

12__ExistingBuilding__Floors.Tag__Description: Existing building floor slabs and finishes.

17__ExistingBuilding__Fixtures.Tag__Description: Existing building fixtures and fittings (sanitary, kitchen, etc.).

19__ExistingBuilding__InteriorDecor.Tag__Description: Existing building interior decor and soft furnishings.

20__ProposedBuilding.Tag__Description: Proposed building - whole massing flag. Used for simplified massing models where the entire proposed building is a single object.

22__ProposedBuilding__Floors.Tag__Description: Proposed building floor slabs and finishes.

27__ProposedBuilding__Fixtures.Tag__Description: Proposed building fixtures and fittings (sanitary, kitchen, etc.).

29__ProposedBuilding__InteriorDecor.Tag__Description: Proposed building interior decor and soft furnishings.

39__GroundFloorDecor.Tag__Description: Ground floor high detail decor items.

49__FirstFloorDecor.Tag__Description: First floor high detail decor items.

60__Scene__Entourage__2D.Tag__Description: 2D planar scene entourage components that always face the camera (billboard / camera-follow). Lightweight background people, pets, and similar linework or face assets authored as flat SketchUp components. Sibling of 09__Site__Vegetation__2D, carved out of the 60-70 Scene Context range. Exported as a dedicated GLB segment for separate visibility control in ValeVision and TrueVision. Holds the Detailed (linework) entourage standard; fill-only silhouettes go on 61__Scene__Entourage__Silhouette so they switch on/off separately.

61__Scene__Entourage__Silhouette.Tag__Description: Fill-only 2D camera-follow entourage silhouettes (SceneEntourage2D__Billboard__ family, {Type} prefixed Silhouette, e.g. 60_0301__SceneEntourage__SilhouettePerson__*). Own GLB segment, so silhouettes switch on/off separately from the Detailed entourage on tag 60 - in the ValeVision layer toggle menu, per SketchUp scene (Cloud Sync tag visibility) and per Video Studio path. Linework is suppressed for everything on this tag. Carved out of the Scene Context range, which narrows to 62-70.

62_70__SceneContextual.Tag__Description: Scene context objects - people, vehicles, site elements (tags 62 through 70). 2D camera-follow billboard people/pets use tag 60__Scene__Entourage__2D, and fill-only silhouettes use 61__Scene__Entourage__Silhouette, instead.

71_75__SitePlanTags__.Tag__Description: Site plan drawing tags (71-75). Geometry on these tags is 2D site plan linework, with fills from closed faces on fill tags (SitePlan__ExportFills) - and a fill tag's faces export even when none of their edges are on that tag, so tagging just the FACE is enough to wash it. Exported ONLY by the GlbBuilder Site Plan Export - one GLB per tag NAME - into the project's 30__TrueVision__AppContent site plan folder (SitePlan__DrawingData__Existing, __Proposed, or the original SitePlan__DrawingData), for TrueVision3D Site Plan drawings. Similar layers share a number and differ by name. Every tag is listed in ExportExclusions.FullyExcludedTagNames, so the model export never writes it, and in AdvancedSwapOffTagNames, so Edge Paint leaves its edges alone. Deliberately no Glb__ExportFileNameStem: the ValeVision Cloud Sync stem map must not treat these as 3D layers. WEIGHTS ARE IN POINTS (SitePlan__LineWeightPt), the LayOut convention; SitePlan__LineWeightMm is the same figure converted (1 pt = 0.352778 mm) and is what TrueVision reads. Z-INDEX: SitePlan__ZIndexLine and SitePlan__ZIndexFill are 1-10, 10 highest, and are INDEPENDENT - water lines sit above tree lines while the fills stack on their own. SitePlan__DrawOrder is kept beside them, untouched, because every already-published manifest carries it. A RENAMED TAG KEEPS ITS OLD STEM: the stem is the identity key behind every saved layer toggle and style override in TrueVision, and SitePlan__LegacyTagNames lets a model still tagged with the retired name export to the same layer.

71__SitePlan__BaseMap__OsMapping__Genera.Tag__Description: OS or map-provider mapping imported as DXF, everything not on one of the more specific OS tags. Group the import and tag the group; the raw edges inside stay Untagged.

71__SitePlan__BaseMap__OsMapping__MainRo.Tag__Description: Main roads and their kerb lines, read heavier than the rest of the base map so the road hierarchy is legible at a glance.

71__SitePlan__BaseMap__OsMapping__MinorS.Tag__Description: Minor streets, lanes and service roads: the base map's everyday road linework.

71__SitePlan__BaseMap__OsMapping__MajorF.Tag__Description: Base map detail that carries the site - a substantial outbuilding, a bridge, a retaining wall, a tank: the things a reader navigates by. The same dark grey as the roads and the general base map, and heavier than OsMapping__MinorFeature, so the base map has a hierarchy of its own instead of one flat grey.

71__SitePlan__BaseMap__OsMapping__MinorF.Tag__Description: The lightest base map detail - steps, small walls, kerb returns, incidental linework. The finest weight on the drawing.

71__SitePlan__BaseMap__NeighbouringBuild.Tag__Description: Neighbouring buildings traced from the OS map. Not a proposal and not an existing building ON the site: its own tag so it can never draw red.

71__SitePlan__BaseMap__Waterbodies.Tag__Description: Ponds, lakes, rivers and canals. Draw closed FACES: the face carries the water wash and its Ponds & Lakes hatch, its edges the blue outline.

71__SitePlan__BaseMap__Amendments.Tag__Description: Linework added or corrected where the OS mapping is out of date - a neighbour's extension, a surveyed boundary. Drawn to match the OS mapping.

71__SitePlan__BaseMap__Contours.Tag__Description: Contours and level breaks from a topographical survey. Off by default at every scale.

72__SitePlan__Boundary__RedLine.Tag__Description: The application site boundary - the red line. A closed loop of edges at ground level. The highest thing on the drawing: nothing may draw over it.

72__SitePlan__Boundary__BlueLine.Tag__Description: Other land owned or controlled by the applicant - the blue line.

72__SitePlan__Boundary__WallsAndFences.Tag__Description: Walls, fences, gates and piers the drawing needs beyond the OS linework.

72__SitePlan__Boundary__WallsAndFences__.Tag__Description: Walls, fences, gates and piers being REMOVED from the site. The same mid grey DOTTED line as 74__SitePlan__ExternalWorks__HardSurfaces__Removed (TrueVision's dotted: 0.4 mm dots, 1.2 mm gaps), so everything being taken out reads alike. Lines only - no fill. The 0.75 pt weight and line Z 3 of Walls and Fences: a fence that stays is soft black and solid, one being removed is mid grey and dotted. MOVE the fence's edges onto this tag rather than tracing over them - dots painted over a solid line read solid. The tag also takes SketchUp's Dot line style, so it reads dotted in the model.
72__SitePlan__Boundary__WallsAndFences__.SitePlan__LayerLabel: Walls and Fences To Be Removed

72__SitePlan__Boundary__SettingOutLines.Tag__Description: Distances to boundaries, building lines, and the 45 and 25 degree test lines.

73__SitePlan__Buildings__Existing.Tag__Description: Existing buildings on the site that stay. Outline only - no fill, so the proposal reads against it.

73__SitePlan__Buildings__Existing__Remov.Tag__Description: Existing buildings being REMOVED from the site - where a building stood. A blue, SMALL dotted line: TrueVision's dotted at half size (SitePlan__LineDashScale 0.5 - 0.2 mm dashes on a 0.8 mm repeat, which the round caps of a 0.5 pt line draw as 0.38 mm dots with 0.42 mm gaps, twice as close as the other removal lines). Lines only - no fill. Line Z 5, level with the other buildings. The tag takes SketchUp's Dot line style, so it reads dotted in the model. 73__SitePlan__Buildings__ToBeDemolished (soft black, dashed) is a separate, older tag.

73__SitePlan__Buildings__Proposed__NewCo.Tag__Description: Proposed NEW buildings and extensions, as a roof outline. Draw closed FACES at ground level: the face is the red wash, its edges the outline.

73__SitePlan__Buildings__Proposed__Alter.Tag__Description: Proposed ALTERATIONS to an existing building - re-roofing, re-fenestration, remodelling within the footprint. Dashed, so it reads apart from new build at a glance.

73__SitePlan__SiteFeature__Access.Tag__Description: The site's vehicular access - the drive, the entrance, the turning head. Read at the same weight as a main road, because that is what it joins. Draw closed FACES for the light grey hard standing wash (MAT806); its edges the outline.

73__SitePlan__SiteFeature__Paths.Tag__Description: Footpaths, terraces and garden paths within the site. Its faces wash in the warm paving grey (MAT807), the same as Paths and Paving; its edges are the outline.

74__SitePlan__ExternalWorks__HardSurface.Tag__Description: Driveways, parking areas, paths, patios, terraces and tracks, where the job needs them called out separately from the simple Site Features pair. Draw closed FACES for the light grey hard standing wash (MAT806); its edges the outline.

Paths, drives, roads, hard standing and paving being REMOVED from within the site. A mid grey DOTTED line (TrueVision's dotted: 0.4 mm dots, 1.2 mm gaps) that shows where the surface was and reads apart at once from the solid lines of what stays. Lines only - no fill; the ground it leaves is whatever is drawn beneath. The colour, 0.75 pt weight and line Z 2 of Site Paths, which carries RB05's drive and path lines, so only the dots tell the two apart. The tag also takes SketchUp's Dot line style, so it reads dotted in the model.

74__SitePlan__ExternalWorks__ParkingAndA.Tag__Description: Parking bays, turning heads, visibility splays and access widths, where these are drawn in detail.

74__SitePlan__ExternalWorks__DrainageAnd.Tag__Description: Soakaways, drainage runs, manholes, trial pits and service routes.

74__SitePlan__ExternalWorks__HardStandin.Tag__Description: A FILL tag: hard standing and paved driveways - drives, parking courts, yards and turning heads. Tag the FACE and it washes in the neutral hard standing grey (MAT806); it needs no edges of its own, so a face formed by the drive's existing lines can simply be given this tag. Any edges it does carry draw exactly like Site Paths (mid grey, 0.75 pt, line Z 2), so a traced drive merges into the line it was traced from.

74__SitePlan__ExternalWorks__PathsAndPav.Tag__Description: A FILL tag: paths and paving - footpaths, patios, terraces and paved areas. Tag the FACE and it washes in the warm paving grey (MAT807), a shade lighter than the drives so the two surfaces read apart. Needs no edges of its own; any it carries draw exactly like Site Paths.

74__SitePlan__ExternalWorks__StillWater.Tag__Description: A FILL tag: still water - swimming pools, formal ponds, rills and water features. Washes in the same water blue as Waterbodies (MAT802) but with NO ripple hatch, so a pool reads as calm, contained water rather than as a lake. Tag the FACE and it fills; it needs no edges of its own. Any edges it carries draw exactly like Waterbodies (blue, 1.0 pt, line Z 7). Fill Z 4, level with the other water, so a pool paints over the paving round it.

75__SitePlan__SoftLandscape__Trees__Mixe.Tag__Description: Woodland and tree belts drawn as an AREA, not as individual canopies. Draw closed FACES: the face carries the green wash and its Mixed Woodland hatch, its edges the outline.

75__SitePlan__SoftLandscape__Trees__Exis.Tag__Description: Individual existing trees, drawn as a canopy circle with a stem mark.

75__SitePlan__SoftLandscape__HedgesAndPl.Tag__Description: Hedges and planting beds. Draw closed FACES for the green wash; its edges the outline.

75__SitePlan__SoftLandscape__Trees__ToBe.Tag__Description: Trees and hedges to be removed.

75__SitePlan__SoftLandscape__RootProtect.Tag__Description: BS 5837 root protection areas and protective fencing.

75__SitePlan__SoftLandscape__Grassland.Tag__Description: Fields, paddocks, lawns and open grass, drawn as an AREA. Draw closed FACES with their edges ON THIS TAG: the face carries the pale green wash and its Grassland hatch. The edges draw exactly like the OS base map lines (dark grey, 0.5 pt, line Z 1), so a field traced over its OS boundary merges into the same line and adds nothing to the drawing. Fill Z 1, the bottom of the stack: every other wash - drives, woodland, water, the proposal - paints over grass. A face whose edges all sit on ANOTHER tag exports nothing, because the site plan export skips a layer with no edges of its own.

75__SitePlan__SoftLandscape__RoughGrassl.Tag__Description: Rough grass, tussock, field margins and uncut verges, drawn as an AREA. Draw closed FACES with their edges ON THIS TAG: the face carries the olive-grey wash and its Rough Grassland hatch; the edges draw exactly like the OS base map lines, as Grassland's do. Fill Z 1, beside Grassland at the bottom of the stack.

76_79__LineworkModifierTags__.Tag__Description: Nested detail-weight tags (agreed 20-Sep-2026, made host-universal 20-Sep-2026). Applied to a group or component NESTED INSIDE an already-tagged parent - never used at the top level of a model, or as a direct child of a Storey container, on their own. The parent can be ANY numbered building-element category - Walls, Roofs, Floors, Windows, Doors, Staircase, Fixtures, whatever the assembly happens to be modelled inside - because nothing in the GlbBuilder or in TrueVision3D's Stage Sampler ever inspects the parent's tag, only the modifier tag's OWN name. A cupola's louvres can sit inside a Roofs group and still be tagged with a WindowsAndJoinery-family tag; a bullseye window's dressed masonry can sit inside a Walls group tagged with a Walls-family tag. The '__Walls' / '__WindowsAndJoinery' half of each name describes the STYLE FAMILY the detail reads as (masonry/structural vs joinery/glazing), never a required parent. Because the tag differs from its ancestor's, the GlbBuilder's per-entity bucketing gives the nested geometry its own glTF mesh node name ('OwnTagName::MaterialName') while the mesh itself still lands in the PARENT's GLB - so the object stays on exactly the same TrueVision category, storey and visibility toggle as whatever hosts it, but TrueVision3D's projected-linework pipeline can tell its edges apart and draw them at a lighter weight. Carries no Glb__ExportRangeNumbers: it is never a standalone export bucket, only ever a rider inside a parent tag's subtree - and because of that, it is also never a valid direct child of a Storey container (90-93): Na__ExportCore__OrganizeStoreyChildrenByTags only recognises tags with a registered Storey__ElementExportName, so a modifier tag sitting bare at that level is silently skipped and never reaches any GLB at all. LineworkModifier__StyleKey is the TrueVision__LineworkModifier__* owner key a drawing editor resolves to a weight/colour via Na__LayoutEditor__ModelLayers__Config__.json, and must match an entry in Na__ProjectedLinework__AppConfig__.json -> ProjectedLinework__LineworkModifiers__Config.

76__LineworkModifier__FineDetail__Walls.Tag__Description: Fine masonry/structural-styled detail - stonework, cills, projecting bands and similar. Reads lighter than whatever it sits on. Nest inside ANY numbered category (Walls is the common case, but a Roofs or Floors parent works exactly the same) - never at a model's top level or as a bare Storey child.
76__LineworkModifier__FineDetail__Walls.LineworkModifier__AppliesToHostCategorie: any - the exporter and Stage Sampler never inspect the parent's tag, only this tag's own name; documented here only as the family's TYPICAL host, not an enforced one

77__LineworkModifier__FineDetail__Window.Tag__Description: Fine joinery/glazing-styled detail - mullions, sub-frames, louvres and similar. Reads lighter than whatever it sits on. Nest inside ANY numbered category (Windows or Doors is the common case, but a Roofs parent - a cupola's louvres - works exactly the same) - never at a model's top level or as a bare Storey child.
77__LineworkModifier__FineDetail__Window.LineworkModifier__AppliesToHostCategorie: any - the exporter and Stage Sampler never inspect the parent's tag, only this tag's own name; documented here only as the family's TYPICAL host, not an enforced one

78__LineworkModifier__VeryFineDetail__Wa.Tag__Description: Very fine masonry/structural-styled detail - fine mouldings, reveals and similar backed-off detail. Reads lighter than 76__LineworkModifier__FineDetail__Walls. Nest inside ANY numbered category - never at a model's top level or as a bare Storey child.
78__LineworkModifier__VeryFineDetail__Wa.LineworkModifier__AppliesToHostCategorie: any - the exporter and Stage Sampler never inspect the parent's tag, only this tag's own name; documented here only as the family's TYPICAL host, not an enforced one

79__LineworkModifier__VeryFineDetail__Wi.Tag__Description: Very fine joinery/glazing-styled detail - glazing bars, ironmongery, louvres and similar backed-off detail. Reads lighter than 77__LineworkModifier__FineDetail__WindowsAndJoinery. Nest inside ANY numbered category - never at a model's top level or as a bare Storey child.
79__LineworkModifier__VeryFineDetail__Wi.LineworkModifier__AppliesToHostCategorie: any - the exporter and Stage Sampler never inspect the parent's tag, only this tag's own name; documented here only as the family's TYPICAL host, not an enforced one

90__Storey__GroundFloor.Tag__Description: Storey container tag - Ground Floor. Groups all ground floor geometry for storey-level visibility control.

ExportExclusions.Description: Tags and patterns used by the GlbBuilder to control entity visibility during GLB export. FullyExcludedTagNames are completely invisible in the GLB. TreatAsUntaggedTagNames are exported as Layer0 geometry (visible in 3D viewer but not segmented by tag).
ExportExclusions.PatternExclusionNote: Any tag matching this pattern (TrueVision_{wildcard}_DoNotExportGLTF) is excluded from export at all nesting depths.
ExportExclusions.FullyExcludedNote: Entities on these tags are completely skipped during GLB export at any nesting depth. Site plan tags (71-75, entries carrying SitePlan__ExportFileNameStem) are listed so the model export never writes them; the Site Plan Export reads them through SitePlanExportConfig.
ExportExclusions.LineworkHiddenNote: Entities on these tags export mesh geometry normally but all edges are suppressed in the linework GLB at any nesting depth. A group or component tagged with one of these names short-circuits the entire subtree from edge collection. Both canonical and legacy names are listed for backward compatibility with existing models.
ExportExclusions.AdvancedSwapOffNote: Edges already assigned to one of these tags are not reassigned during Advanced mode tag application in the Edge Paint plugin. Both canonical and legacy names are listed for backward compatibility with existing models.
ExportExclusions.TreatAsUntaggedNote: Entities on these tags are exported in the GLB but treated as Layer0/Untagged for segmentation. Edge vertex colours (MTE greyscale) are preserved for downstream depth cueing.

SitePlanExportConfig.Description: Runtime config for the GlbBuilder Site Plan Export and for the readers of its output (the ProjectVision build script, TrueVision3D site plan drawings). Site plan layers are the Na__DataLib__CoreIndex__Tags entries that carry SitePlan__ExportFileNameStem.
SitePlanExportConfig.TagNumberRangeNote: 71-75 hold the site plan tags. Similar layers share a number and differ by name: the NAME picks the GLB, never the number (unlike 10-29).
SitePlanExportConfig.StyleUnitsNote: SitePlan__LineDashScale multiplies the dash pattern of SitePlan__LineType for this tag only, so a layer can keep a line type and still read at a site plan scale: 0.5 halves both the dash and the gap. Absent or 1.0 is the line type as the TrueVision EdgeStyles config defines it, and it does nothing at all to a solid line or to the line WEIGHT. SitePlan__LineWeightMm is paper millimetres. SitePlan__LineType takes the TrueVision EdgeStyles aliases: solid, dashed, dashed-fine, centre, centre-fine, phantom, dotted. Colour ids are Na__DataLib__CoreIndex__EdgeMaterials keys. SitePlan__VisibleAtScales lists the scale denominators a layer is switched on at when a site plan viewport is created.

LinetypeExportConfig.Description: Runtime config for the GlbBuilder Linetype Linework Export and for the readers of its output (TrueVision3D and ValeVision3D drawing editors). Linetype tags are the Na__DataLib__CoreIndex__Tags entries that carry Glb__LineworkOnly. They are authored in SketchUp as ordinary edges on a tag; the export gives each tag a linework GLB of its own so a downstream drawing can draw it with its own line style.
LinetypeExportConfig.TagNamePatternNote: There is no numeric range. Linetype tags live in the 01 and 02 ranges, which the model export skips, and several share a number: the entry's Glb__LineworkOnly flag picks the GLB, never the number.
LinetypeExportConfig.ExportIgnoresTagVisibilityNote: Linetype tags are drawing data, not 3D-view data. A tag switched off in SketchUp still exports, so a model tidied for a render still carries its linework. Hidden entities, and hidden, soft or smooth edges, are still skipped.
LinetypeExportConfig.ExportRunsWithModelExportNote: The files are written into the model export folder alongside the mesh and linework GLBs, so the standard multi-model loader discovers them by filename with no manifest.
LinetypeExportConfig.CategoryKeyNote: The loader turns {prefix}TrueVision__Linetype__Name__LineworkModel__.glb into the runtime category TrueVision__Linetype__Name. That key is what a drawing editor's ModelLayers config maps to a label, a colour, a weight and a line type.
LinetypeExportConfig.SketchUpTagFolderNote: New linetype tags created by the Tag Manager are filed in this tag folder. ModelFlag linetype tags (01 range) are left where they are - they are modelling flags first.
LinetypeExportConfig.LegacyTagNamesNote: Glb__LineworkLegacyTagNames lists older SketchUp names for the same tag. Geometry on a legacy name lands in the same GLB as the canonical one, so a model tagged up before the tag was renamed still draws.
LinetypeExportConfig.LineTypeAliasesNote: Glb__LineworkLineType takes one of these TrueVision EdgeStyles aliases - the same vocabulary SitePlan__LineType uses.

LineworkModifierConfig.Description: Runtime config for the nested detail-weight tags (agreed 20-Sep-2026, superseding the earlier Na__-prefixed nested sub-tag idea - see Tag__Description on 76_79__LineworkModifierTags__ for why; made host-universal 20-Sep-2026, same day). LineworkModifier tags are Na__DataLib__CoreIndex__Tags entries that carry LineworkModifier__StyleKey. They are applied to a group or component nested inside an already-tagged parent of ANY numbered category - a cupola's louvres inside a Roofs group, a dressed opening inside a Walls group, equally - and are never used at a model's top level or as a bare Storey-container child.
LineworkModifierConfig.TagNumberRangeNote: 76-89 was entirely free before this range was reserved (confirmed empty in every SSOT entry, the GlbBuilder's number-matching code, and the TagsManager creation ranges). 76-79 is spoken for; 80-89 stays free for future detail tiers or host families.
LineworkModifierConfig.ExportBucketNote: LineworkModifier tags carry no Glb__ExportRangeNumbers and are never registered as an export bucket of their own - the GlbBuilder's Pass 1 (which GLB an entity's whole subtree lands in) only ever looks at the OUTERMOST tag, so a LineworkModifier tag placed at a model's top level by mistake matches no range and its geometry silently does not export. It must always be nested inside a tagged parent.
LineworkModifierConfig.NodeNamingNote: Pass 2 of the GlbBuilder (Na__GlbEngine__TraverseEntities, per-entity bucket_key) already treats ANY tag that differs from its parent's as its own glTF node name ('OwnTagName::MaterialName'), generically, with no code change required for this range. TrueVision3D's projected-linework Stage Sampler reads the first '::'-delimited segment of a mesh's own node name against ProjectedLinework__LineworkModifiers__Config in Na__ProjectedLinework__AppConfig__.json to resolve LineworkModifier__StyleKey, and draws that mesh's edges at the paired weight/colour from Na__LayoutEditor__ModelLayers__Config__.json instead of inheriting its parent category's style. Visibility, storey membership and the Model Layers toggle are untouched - they still follow the parent category's THREE.Group, because the geometry never leaves the parent's GLB.
LineworkModifierConfig.SectionClassCaveat: TrueVision3D's projected-linework pipeline deliberately excludes the section (cut) class from per-category restyling - an edge actually sliced by a drawing's cut plane always reads as cut material, whatever it is. A LineworkModifier style only lightens a mesh's visible/hidden/authored (projected, silhouette) edges, not a cut line running straight through it.

GlbBuilderConfig.Description: Plugin-level runtime config for the TrueVision3D GlbBuilder. Layered: this block is the GitHub-shared default; an optional Na__TrueVision__GlbBuilder__AppConfig__.json in the plugin folder may override individual keys.

Logging.ConsoleVerboseNote: When false, all per-entity export messages skip the Sketchup Ruby Console (major speed win). Enable for live debugging only.
Logging.TextFileEnabledNote: When true, a complete export log is written to the selected export folder alongside the GLB files.
Logging.TextFileNameNote: %TIMESTAMP% is expanded to YYYY-MM-DD_HHMMSS at export time.

LineStyleReference.Description: Authoritative list of SketchUp Ruby API line style names accepted by Sketchup::Layer#line_style= via Sketchup.active_model.line_styles[name]. Names are CASE SENSITIVE per the official API. Use any value below as a tag's Layout__LineStyleName field to programmatically apply a non-solid line style to that SketchUp tag (layer). Note: this is the ONLY supported way to set tag line styles from Ruby - SketchUp does not expose a freeform stroke pattern API like Layout::Style does, so you are limited to this fixed set of named styles built into the running model. Apply via the TagManager (na_apply_line_style_to_tag) which guards on respond_to? for backwards compatibility.

TagTemplate__Example.Description: Copy this object as a starting point when adding a new tag that needs a non-solid line style. Replace NN with a numeric prefix that matches one of the established ranges, fill in Category and Subcategory, then set Layout__LineStyleName to one of the AvailableLineStyles values above. Optional Layout__EdgeColourRGB is the [R, G, B] colour applied to the tag's swatch when the tag is created at runtime.
TagTemplate__Example.Tag__Description: Describe what this tag is for and why a non-solid line style is appropriate.
